mandates.thresholdNote: Invoices over EUR 5,000 to public administration suppliers.

Under Law 18/2022 ('Crea y Crece'): once the implementing technical regulations are enacted, companies with EUR 8 million+ annual revenue get a 1-year compliance deadline, other businesses a 2-year deadline. As of this source's 2025-02-04 publication date, the technical regulations were still pending and no firm effective date had been set — this is why no effectiveDate is given here rather than one being guessed.
mandates.notes: Spain separately requires 'Verifactu'-certified invoicing software and near-real-time reporting for most businesses (related anti-fraud/reporting regime, distinct from this structural B2B e-invoicing mandate) — not modeled as its own mandate row here since it is a software-certification/reporting requirement rather than an invoice-format mandate, and this project has not independently verified its exact effective date against a primary source.
